extraction.name: Visual Question Answering: Datasets, Algorithms, and Future Challenges
extraction.description: A review of Visual Question Answering (VQA) problem in computer vision and natural language processing
extraction.creator: Kushal Ka and Christopher Kanan
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The datasets used for VQA are DAQUAR, COCO-QA, The VQA Dataset, FM-IQA, Visual7W, and Visual Genome. These datasets are sourced from various image datasets such as NYU-DepthV2, Microsoft Common Objects in Context (COCO), and Flickr100M.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Document analysis, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes images from NYU-DepthV2, COCO, and Flickr100M datasets.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotations were created by Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers and other annotators. The questions and answers were generated using various methods, including natural language processing algorithms and manual annotation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The multiple answers per question are used in the consensus-based evaluation metric for the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: VQA has potential applications for aiding blind and visually impaired individuals, improving human-computer interaction, and image retrieval.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The datasets contain biases in the distribution of questions and answers, which can be exploited by algorithms to perform well without truly solving the VQA problem.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The limitations of current datasets include small size, biases, and lack of diversity in questions and answers.
